root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.ContactsTbl', N'DeliveryOnBehalf') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.ContactsTbl ADD DeliveryOnBehalf BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Contacts_DeliveryOnBehalf DEFAULT (0); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactDeliverToAddressTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.ContactDeliverToAddressTbl ( DeliverToAddressID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, ContactID INT NOT NULL, Label NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, DeliverToPerson NVARCHAR(100) NULL, Address1 NVARCHAR(100) NULL, Address2 NVARCHAR(100) NULL, Address3 NVARCHAR(100) NULL, AreaID INT NULL, StateOrProvince NVARCHAR(50) NULL, PostalCode NVARCHAR(20) NULL, Latitude DECIMAL(9, 6) NULL, Longitude DECIMAL(9, 6) NULL, ToBeDeliveredByID INT NULL, SortOrder INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ContactDeliverTo_SortOrder DEFAULT (0), Enabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ContactDeliverTo_Enabled DEFAULT (1), CONSTRAINT PK_ContactDeliverToAddressTbl PRIMARY KEY (DeliverToAddressID) ); CREATE INDEX IX_ContactDeliverTo_Contact ON dbo.ContactDeliverToAddressTbl (ContactID, Enabled, SortOrder) INCLUDE (Label, DeliverToPerson, AreaID, Latitude, Longitude, ToBeDeliveredByID); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactDeliverToAddressTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.ContactDeliverToAddressTbl', N'LocationStatus') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.ContactDeliverToAddressTbl ADD Geohash VARCHAR(12) NULL, GeocodedAddress NVARCHAR(500) NULL, SourceAddress NVARCHAR(500) NULL, LocationStatus VARCHAR(20) NULL, Source VARCHAR(20) NULL, LocationUpdatedDate DATETIME NULL, LocationUpdatedBy NVARCHAR(128) NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.OrdersTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.OrdersTbl', N'DeliverToAddressID') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.OrdersTbl ADD DeliverToAddressID INT NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_Orders_DeliverToAddress ON dbo.OrdersTbl (DeliverToAddressID) WHERE DeliverToAddressID IS NOT NULL; END
